newsitem.title: USA: Investment manager has stake in CANTV.
newsitem.headline: Investment manager has stake in CANTV.

text.p: Everest Capital Ltd, a Bermuda investment manager for three investment funds, said on Tuesday that it acquired the equivalent of 16,204,300 class D shares of Compania Anonima Nacional Telefonos de Venezuela (CANTV), or 5.16 percent of the total outstanding.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Everest said it acquired the stake for $50.3 million for investment purposes.

Of the stake, 12,704,300 shares are owned through 1,814,900 American Depository Receipt shares, each of which represents seven shares, and the other 3.5 million shares are owned through options to buy 500,000 ADR's, Everest said.
Of the total, Everest said it bought 1,240,895 shares between Dec. 17, 1996 and Feb. 12, 1997 at prices ranging from $26.50 to $30.80 a share.
